source: BAM, Schilling M., Glaubitz S., Matzak K., Rehmer B., Skrotzki B. (2022): Full dataset of several mechanical tests on an S355 steel sheet as reference data for digital representations, version 1.0.0. Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.6778336. CC BY 4.0. Values transcribed from tensile_test.zip, 02_secondary_data/results_protocols/tensile_test_results.xlsx (sheets Festigkeitskennwerte and Verformungskennwerte), read 2026-11-12.
notes: Tested to DIN EN ISO 6892-1 on an Instron 4505 with an HBM extensometer of 50 mm nominal gauge length; the extension column is the extensometer's, in %.

The extensometer was removed at about 3.9 % strain (Zx1: about 1.9 %), so Ag, Agt, At and A cannot be read from the files; A was measured on the broken specimens (L0 = 60 mm) and is given for reference only.
BAM reports ReH, Fm, Rm and E; Rp0.2 and ReL are left empty in the protocol.
Zx1 was run at a higher crosshead speed than the others (protocol remark).
